data.content:
In the Russian Cup, things are going badly for Lokomotiv. The club sit bottom of Group D with two points: a draw with CSKA (1-1) and a penalty shootout defeat, a narrow loss in Rostov (0-1), a goalless draw with Akron and another shootout defeat. In the Cup, the attack simply isn't functioning - 0.33 goals per game, the worst return in the competition. The reason may lie in rotation: Galaktionov is protecting his first-team players for the RPL, and the squad players are not coping with the [...] In the league, Lokomotiv have picked up their second win of the season but remain in the play-off zone. The 5-0 demolition of Fakel in Voronezh was the team's most impressive performance in the competition: Komlichenko scored twice, with further goals from Titkov, Montes and Pogostnov. After the match, Galaktionov noted that the player combinations were dictated by fitness and cohesion. An important league fixture against Krasnodar follows on 17 October, and the coaching staff will almost [...] Morozov and Rudenko will miss the match through suspension. Silyanov is injured, though the problem is not serious. Mostovoy's participation is in doubt. The Cup gives Lokomotiv a chance to give some game time to squad players who have been seeing little action in the RPL.

### Akron Tolyatti

No suspensions. Maradishvili's participation is in doubt due to a minor injury.
